_note: agent: 'opus' = feel-critical or cross-cutting logic; 'sonnet' = data-driven, well-bounded construction. 'touches' lists game/ files (R = ReplicatedStorage/Spark, S = ServerScriptService/Spark, C = StarterPlayerScripts/Spark). Packages in the same stage with disjoint 'touches' may run in parallel. Full briefs for WP-01..WP-05 are in 08_IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.md section 6.

stages.name: CORE FEEL SLICE (Meadow, solo, no progression changes)
stages.gate: CHECKPOINT 1: owner plays the slice in Studio and answers 09 section 3. No stage 2 work before a pass.

stages.name: FULL CONTENT (Canyon, Aurora, wraps, golden, legends, hazard)
stages.gate: CHECKPOINT 2: owner plays all three arenas solo; 2-client co-op test

stages.name: SYSTEMS RE-INTEGRATION (progression, Daily, menus, audio, tests, perf)

packages.title: Design data pipeline
accept: generated modules are byte-reproducible from design/fable/data
spec asserts every id referenced across modules resolves
tools/run_checks.py includes a 'design-data-fresh' check that fails when JSON and Luau differ

packages.title: Loop geometry module
accept: pure, engine-independent, no allocations per frame beyond the ribbon buffer

spec covers: self-intersection close, snap close, min perimeter/area rejects, point-in-polygon incl. inflate, path-tolerance validation accept/reject, pinch closure, 1000 random loops fuzz with no NaN

packages.title: Client feel: predicted dash, camera, ribbon
touches: S/Main.server.luau (Dash handler only: delete LinearVelocity block)
accept: dash begins on the input frame with zero server round trip
no server-created physics constraint remains
ribbon is one Trail; closure preview and cinch use pooled effects
camera matches tuning.camera; setting 'Classic camera' restores Roblox default with zoom clamps

packages.title: Server loop claims, scoring, parade and bank rings
touches: R/Challenge.luau (add Challenge.loop; keep capture for golden/herd paths until WP-13)
accept: a client cannot catch anything it did not physically encircle: adversarial spec (fabricated polygons, replay, oversize, teleport, rate flood) grants nothing
atomic claim preserved (no double catch across two players' simultaneous loops)
bank by running through a ring; no button

no part of the playfield is a flat untextured disc

instance count for Meadow <= 2600 parts incl. client decor

herd traffic within tuning.performance budgets in the headless soak

no HUD element overlaps another or a reserved rect
